overview: Serbia is a landlocked country in the Balkans. Its capital and largest city is Belgrade, which stands where the Sava river joins the Danube. Serbia was the largest republic of Yugoslavia. Kosovo, in the south, declared independence from Serbia in 2008, which Serbia does not recognise.

geography.text: Northern Serbia, a region called Vojvodina, is flat and fertile, part of the Pannonian Plain. Further south the land becomes hilly and then mountainous. The Danube flows through the country and cuts through the dramatic Iron Gates gorge on the border with Romania.
